{{Infobox place|name=Dawnwatch|type=Seat of [[House Ashbourne]]|region=[[the Edgelands]]|house=[[House Ashbourne]]|notable=The Wall of Names; the View East; built for sallying forth}}
'''Dawnwatch''' is a forward fortress facing [[the Silent Mountains]] and the unknown east — built for sallying forth, not for siege: broad gates, everything designed to get riders out fast. On '''the Wall of Names''', every Ashbourne who died in a [[The Leap|Leap]] or border skirmish is carved by their own next of kin. From '''the View East''' there is sometimes light or smoke beyond the mountains that no one can explain.
{{House Ashbourne}}
